name: Best Permutation
justification: 'Print any' construction with many valid outputs; needs a special judge the token checker can't express.
solution_sketch: Zero x out on a small prefix, then place n-1 before n at the end: e.g. for even n use [2,3,...,n-2,1,n-1,n]-style ordering so the final x = 2n-1 (parity-adjusted for odd n).
